name: persist mteb results in default directory layout
definition: place evaluation output under the canonical mteb results path so the evaluation archive contains the expected per-task json.
failure_mode: results written elsewhere or in an unparsed layout fail discovery

name: produce byte-identical fixed-width serialized output
definition: Write each record back with exactly the original field widths and padding so the resulting files are byte-for-byte identical to the expected state.
failure_mode: Extra whitespace, trailing newlines, or truncated padding breaks the exact string comparison.
